capabilities: sort tables by clicking column headers in preview mode
sort by multiple columns with Shift+click priority
sort numeric and date columns correctly
sort tables rendered by the Dataview plugin
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The installation section mistakenly refers to installing 'Homepage'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sort tables interactively in preview mode, and rendered tables from plugins like Dataview cannot be sorted at all.

relations.evidence: Heavily inspired by obsidian-sortable and obsidian-sortable-tables.
Heavily inspired by obsidian-sortable and obsidian-sortable-tables.

summary: Table sorting plugin that sorts any table in preview mode, including Dataview-rendered tables, without changing file contents.
